profile.name: Susan Hall
profile.bio: Susan Hall is the Unity Party candidate for Colorado's 7th congressional district. She is described as a teacher and peace activist and was previously a congressional candidate in 2012 and 2024, when she ran in Colorado's 8th district.
profile.notes: The listed campaign domain susanhallforcongress.com currently redirects to a parking page, and no published platform was found.

profile.name: Kymone Freeman
profile.bio: Kymone Freeman is a Washington, D.C. radio host. He is the D.C. Statehood Green Party nominee for Delegate in 2026, having also run for the seat in 2024.

platform.point: Campaigns on the slogan "No Representation, No Taxes," objecting to District residents paying federal taxes without voting representation.

profile.notes: Campaign site has almost no policy detail and Ballotpedia could not be reached, so no positions could be scored.

profile.name: Ralph Groves
profile.current_role: Former chair, Libertarian Party of Orange County
profile.bio: Ralph Groves recently chaired the Libertarian Party of Orange County, Florida. He served in Army and Defense Department roles in Germany, the United Kingdom, West Africa and Armenia, and holds a Doctor of Arts in history from St. John's University.

platform.point: Defend the individual right to bear arms, oppose gun-free zones and question the effectiveness of background checks.
Expects states to set abortion policy and opposes using taxpayer funds for abortion.
Describes himself as anti-war while supporting U.S. defense industries.
Supports safety courses for gun owners, similar to driver education.

liberty.evidence: Guns: opposes gun-free zones and doubts background checks work; abortion: expects states to set rules and opposes public funding.

foreign.evidence: Describes himself as anti-war while backing U.S. defense industries.

profile.notes: Secondary coverage summarizes his abortion stance as leaving extreme cases to women and doctors, which differs from his position paper.

profile.name: Branden Scrivener
profile.bio: Branden Scrivener is running without party affiliation in Florida's 12th District. He holds a bachelor's degree in human services, has worked in healthcare for over three years, and interned with Catholic Charities and Tampa Crossroads on housing and counseling services.
profile.notes: Very limited public information; no issue positions could be found.

profile.name: Tony D'Arrigo
profile.bio: Tony D'Arrigo is a small-business owner with a background in hospitality management and a published author. He describes himself as a former Republican and is running without party affiliation in Florida's 13th District, refusing corporate PAC money.

platform.point: Expand coverage toward universal care, de-privatize hospitals and protect the ACA.
Protect Medicare and Medicaid and increase Social Security benefits.
Eliminate federal income tax for households earning under $75,000.
Promote affordable clean energy and electric vehicles.
Provide free school meals and child health care.

welfare.evidence: Calls health care his top issue, seeking expanded coverage and de-privatized hospitals.

energy.evidence: Campaign backs affordable clean energy and electric vehicles.

profile.name: Mark Davis
profile.current_role: Air Force veteran and small-business owner
profile.bio: Mark Davis served in the U.S. Air Force from 2005 to 2013 and later worked in corporate retail operations management. He lives in Parrish, Florida, and is running without party affiliation in Florida's 16th Congressional District.

platform.point: Adopt universal health care that covers everyone instead of employer-based or profit-driven plans.
Oppose tariffs and pursue policies to address rising rents, insurance costs and stagnant wages.
Support reproductive freedom and common-sense gun regulations.
Handle immigration and crime with practical policies that respect civil liberties.
Improve services and benefits for veterans.

welfare.evidence: Supports universal health care covering everyone.

liberty.evidence: Abortion: supports reproductive freedom; guns: supports gun regulations.

immigration.evidence: Rejects 'invasion' framing and calls for immigration policy that respects liberty.

profile.notes: The campaign image may not be a formal headshot.
